top_signals.title: Late Billionaire’s Heirs Claims Venezuela Seized Oil Assets
top_signals.summary: The heirs of late Latin American mogul Oswaldo Cisneros accused the Venezuelan government of unjustly confiscating oil-drilling rights and awarding them to a US company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Mexico Weighs Tougher Trade Rules for China as US Talks Grind On
top_signals.summary: Mexico is weighing plans to impose further trade restrictions on selected products from China and other countries while raising existing import taxes on others, according to four people familiar with the matter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: SEC Unveils Crypto Plan as Agency Moves Ahead on Digital Assets
top_signals.summary: The Securities and Exchange Commission unveiled a proposal to exempt certain digital asset offerings from securities registration statements, as the regulator moves ahead with crypto plans after landmark legislation stalled in Congress.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Texas Grid Predicts Record Demand as Heat Rises, Wind Power Sags

top_signals.title: Pokémon Center data breach exposes customer info, cancels some orders
top_signals.summary: Pokémon Center is notifying customers in the United Kingdom and Germany that it suffered a third-party data breach after hackers stole customer personal and order information from third-party logistics provider CEVA Logistics. [...]

top_signals.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
top_signals.summary: A 26-year-old Canadian man once described as one of the most consequential cybercrime threat actors of 2024 has pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy to hack and extort more than 165 organizations that used the cloud data storage provider Snowflake. Connor Riley Moucka, of Kitchener, Ontario, also admitted to stealing call and text history records of more than 100 million AT&T customers.
